data.body:
[P2] Resolve the expanded job subtype contract in the design phase

The description says the issue requires jobs to keep their existing subtypes, but this changes every job context from `RunInChildContext` to `AgentcoreSessionJob`. That expands the public checkpoint contract beyond the stated request. CONTRIBUTING rules 2 and 3 require evaluating the simpler option and agreeing on the API design; the description does not explain why labeling only the session is insufficient. Return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6), compare the two scopes, and obtain maintainer agreement on whether job labels belong in this change.
